Galeria Alma da Rua, Beco do Batman, São Paulo — January 2025

Celopax began his artistic journey in Porto Alegre in 1999 through graffiti. After more than two decades immersed in the streets, he developed a distinctive language marked by geometric forms, vibrant colors, and playful creatures that express the unconscious of metropolitan life.

His work has been exhibited at Konstfack University of Arts in Stockholm, Global Street Art in London, Teufelsberg Occupy Art in Berlin, Les3murs in Paris, and at Galeria A7MA in São Paulo.

This small original on torn paper features his signature neon palette — a central oval form surrounded by layered washes of purple, orange, and yellow. The CELOPAX signature is visible in the lower right.

Acquired at Galeria Alma da Rua, the gallery at the heart of Beco do Batman — São Paulo’s iconic street art district.
